content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the HBCHRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the HBCHRC recruitment is OT Technician (Surgical Oncology).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the OT Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the OT Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed 12th std. in Science, a B.SC with a certificate/Diploma course in OT, and one year of post-qualification internship/work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the OT Technician position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 23,870/- to Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Examination, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur, Punjab.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
